mechanisms.name: Neuron bulk Ca pool fed the whole-soma Ca current (Nicoletti 2019 Eq. 28) instead of the current density
Ionotropic receptor classes with kinetics: per-class dose-response, rise, decay, desensitization, reversal and unit conductance; classes per pair from CeNGEN, transmitter and Fenyves 2020 polarity
Short-term synaptic depression and facilitation at every chemical synapse (graded Dittman-Regehr form; nests Tsodyks-Markram, depression only)
Tap habituation: a slow release resource at the touch cells' output synapses
Slow intracellular states (EGL-4/PKG, CMK-1 fast and slow, GLR-1 trafficking, insulin/DAF-16, DAF-7, CRH-1/CREB), first-order and bounded, scaling release and receptor densities
Activity-dependent channel density tuning (O'Leary integral control on a calcium error; UNC-2 self-tuning over hours)
Slow associative states: salt (ASER, starvation), thermotaxis (AFD, starvation), pathogen (ADF serotonin)
Neuropeptides: UNC-31 dense-core release into four pseudocoelom compartments, every Beets 2023 EC50 pair, GPCR -> Gq/Gi/Gs -> release, NCA, IRK, EGL-19
Monoamines (5-HT, DA, OA, TA): stores, release, MOD-5/DAT-1 reuptake, GPCRs -> G proteins, MOD-1/LGC-55/LGC-53 outside synapses; the same compartments
Quantal (vesicle) release noise at chemical synapses
Ion channel noise at each neuron's soma (diffusion approximation, Linaro 2011)
Temperature: the worm's temperature from the world field, Q10 factors on rates
Salt: ASER salt-OFF and ASEL salt-ON cGMP cascades (Usuyama 2012 network)
Attractive odours: AWC cGMP cascade (Usuyama 2012), AWA ODR-10 -> OSM-9 front end
Repellents: ASH/ADL/PHA/PHB TRPV template, AWB odour-OFF cGMP cascade
Temperature: AFD GCY-8/18/23 cGMP cascade around T*
Oxygen: URX/AQR/PQR GCY-35/36 (O2 up), BAG GCY-31/33 (O2 down) cGMP cascades
Carbon dioxide: BAG GCY-9 cGMP cascade
Light: LITE-1 -> DAF-11/ODR-1 cGMP cascade in ASJ, ASK, ASH, AWB, ASI
Food: NSM DEL-3/7, ADF, ASI, ASJ receptor-channel template
AWA membrane: calcium action potentials (Liu et al. 2018)
Gentle touch: MEC-4/MEC-10 channels in ALM, AVM, PLM, PVM (Sanzeni et al. 2019)
Harsh and nose touch: PVD, FLP (body); ASH, FLP, OLQ, IL1 (nose); Sanzeni template
Plate tap: whole-body indentation pulse to the touch receptor neurons
Proprioception: stretch channels in VB/DB (Wen 2012), DVA (TRP-4), SMD (TRP-1/2)
Body-wall muscle membrane: Du/Crodelle 2025 spiking HH (EGL-19, SHK-1, SLO-2, Kr, NCA, leak)
BWM Ca: Du 2025 Ca shell (nested: lumped sigmoid of V)
BWM Ca -> activation: Boyle-Berri-Cohen 2012 leaky integrator (nested: rise/decay Hill)
BWM-BWM gap junctions (Cook 2019 contacts, Liu 2006 conductance)
Pharynx: Sherman & Harel 2024 muscle cells on Cook wiring, pumps from Ca (nested: lumped clock)
Defecation: 20-cell intestinal IP3R (Li-Rinzel) Ca oscillator and INX-16 wave (nested: 45 s timer)
Intestinal H+ (PBO-4) -> PBO-5/6 cation current in the posterior body-wall muscles
Intestinal NLP-40 release into neuromod's pool (nested direct: an AEX-2 current in AVL and DVB here)
Enteric muscles: Du 2025 membrane, Cook gaps, DVB EXP-1 synapses, Ca -> activation
Egg-laying circuit: 16 sex muscles (Du membrane, UNC-103 as Kr), Cook HSN/VC/VA/VB/VD wiring, uterine stretch, 5-HT/NLP-3 from B1's pools, uv1 tyramine -> HSN LGC-55 (nested: two-state timer)
UNC-103 ERG K+ in the sex muscles at the vulval density (off: the unc-103 null)
GLR (6) and CEPsh (4) glia as passive cells with Cook's gaps to RME, CEP, RIP, ADF, ASI and the head muscles
Extracellular K+ at each side's amphid endings, cleared by glial Kir4.1-type uptake; the K+ reversal shift drives the amphid neurons (nested: null = no glial uptake, fixed = no compartment)
Amphid sheath KCC-3 Cl- microdomain at AFD's ending; Cl- inhibits GCY-8: out['afd_gc_scale'] (nested: null = kcc-3, fixed = scale 1)
Hypodermis, head mesodermal cell, excretory cell and gland as passive cells with Cook's gaps
Body fluid volume and pressure: osmotic water influx against pressure, the excretory canal removing it at a setpoint; out['pressure_kPa'] (nested: null = canal ablated, fixed = constant)
Six coelomocytes' fluid-phase uptake as the pseudocoelom's clearance; out['coelomocyte_uptake_per_s'] (nested: null = cup, off = neuromod's placeholder)
Na/K-ATPase per neuron and muscle (Luo-Rudy 1994 form): activity-driven Na+ load, pump current from rest, ATP cost to metabolism (nested: rest, null = ouabain)

Dynamic Energy Budget (AmP C. elegans abj: reserve, structure, maturity, reproduction buffer), fed by pharyngeal pumping; out['energy_state'], out['egg_production_per_h'] (nested: std, store = the lumped layer)
DEB feeding: scaled functional response from pumps x food (nested: food only, fixed)
GCaMP observation: cooperative Ca binding with first-order kinetics, per indicator variant
Optogenetic actuator GUR-3/PRDX-2 (Randi 2023), targeted light on a schedule
NeuroPAL identity uncertainty (unlabelled, wrong-neighbour labels)
Tierpsy-style gait features of the recorded midline (offline readout, gait_features())
3D tetrahedral body (984 vertices, 3341 tets), MetaWorm mesh
elastic tissue: corotated linear FEM, one homogeneous material
body-wall muscles: 96 linear fibre segments in 4 quadrants
inertia: mass 10 over the 0.63-unit body, numerical damping
fluid: quadratic drag and lift per surface triangle

rows.source_quote: The excitability threshold of BAG was below 0.25% CO 2 . A plot of mean fluorescence ratio change against percent (%) CO 2 suggests that BAG reaches half-maximal activity at ∼2.9% CO 2
